notes: NOT_IN_PACKET: explicit per-arm ovulation event counts and assessment window. Both held documents report only ovulation rates of 64% in the metformin group and 72% in the placebo group; served event counts 71 and 82 are reconstructed in row.json.source, not printed source observations, and are therefore not extracted. Stated allocation totals 111 and 114 match the served denominators. The abstract lists 228 participants but does not explain the discrepancy with the arm allocation totals. The held XML contains the abstract, not the full study body, and links a correction whose contents are not in the packet. The held registration is ISRCTN55906981; the row source description calls the trial NCT-registered without supporting held evidence.
